name: Visionary
source:
Visionary is an 18+ sci-fi/romance visual novel set on a cruise ship.  It features 3  romanceable characters whose stories will change based on your choices.

[From [url=https://obcerd.itch.io/visionary-discontinued]Itch.io[/url]]
